intent: A shared list of text items, for a group that all holds the same link. State is exactly {items: [{id: string, text: string, done: boolean}]}. A freshly minted list, before anyone calls a verb, has whatever initial state its owner seeded (an empty list is {items: []}); every public verb also tolerates state that has no items field yet by treating it as []. add({text: string, 1-500 chars}) appends {id, text, done: false} to the end of items, where id is a fresh string generated by the verb (not supplied by the caller), and returns the new item. toggle({id: string}) finds the item whose id matches and flips its done flag; it returns true if an item was found and flipped, false if no item has that id. remove({id: string}) deletes the item whose id matches from items; it returns true if one was removed, false if none matched. clear() empties items back to [] and returns true; it is owner-only, for wiping the list. add, toggle, and remove are public: anyone holding the app's link may call them with no authentication. There is no undo — remove and clear are permanent.

add.description: Append a new item with the given text to the end of the list.
add.code: ctx.state.items = ctx.state.items ?? []; const item = { id: ctx.now.toString(36) + "-" + Math.floor(ctx.random() * 1e9).toString(36), text: ctx.input.text, done: false }; ctx.state.items.push(item); return item;

toggle.description: Flip the done flag of the item with the given id.

id.description: The id of the item to toggle.

toggle.code: ctx.state.items = ctx.state.items ?? []; const item = ctx.state.items.find(function (i) { return i.id === ctx.input.id; }); if (!item) return false; item.done = !item.done; return true;

remove.description: Delete the item with the given id.

id.description: The id of the item to remove.

remove.code: ctx.state.items = ctx.state.items ?? []; const before = ctx.state.items.length; ctx.state.items = ctx.state.items.filter(function (i) { return i.id !== ctx.input.id; }); return ctx.state.items.length < before;

clear.description: Empty the list back to no items. Owner only.
